about: DropIntel war history: one reading of the Helldivers 2 war every 15 minutes. Times are Unix seconds.

definition.title: MAJOR ORDER
definition.briefing: Defend against the required number of Terminid attacks in order to contain the unprovoked, unforeseeable outbreak affecting multiple TCS+ sectors.

definition.title: MAJOR ORDER
definition.briefing: Eliminate the mandated number of Terminids in order to restore public confidence, quell unlawful rumours of TCS+ failures, and safeguard Federal prosperity.

definition.title: MAJOR ORDER
definition.briefing: Hold the designated planets in order to enable the Firebreak Protocol, to raze infested planets and stop the spread of the mutated Terminid strain.

setting.overrideBrief: Hold the planet chosen for construction of the Center for Mental Clarity and kill Voteless to catalyze research into innovative SEAF mental health treatments.

definition.title: STRATEGIC THREAT
definition.briefing: Investigate and, if warranted, hold the designated planets, in order to verify highly unlikely reports of TCS+ breaches.
